# How teams handle duplicate feature requests

Inspected 2026-10-15.

## Question

How do feedback tools reduce duplicate requests, and does any let the submitter choose?

## Findings

- Placeholder finding for the fixture: two tools show similar requests while typing (claimed, vendor pages); one merges automatically (observed in a trial).

## Limits

Three tools checked; no usage data.

## Implications

Suggest-while-typing is the common pattern; automatic merging is the outlier.
